about: Fixed questions for Ask POLARIS. Each expected fact was checked by hand against the text of the expected record (its title, summary or catalogue fields) before the run. A question passes when the answer cites an expected record AND states every expected fact (any one spelling per fact). Off-topic questions pass when the answer says the archive does not have it.
